## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-*juan* Northern-Sòng commentary by Yuánqīng 源清 (d. 1000) on Zhànrán's *Shí bùèr mén* ([KR6d0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0157), T1927) integrated with the broader Lotus *shí miào* 十妙 ("ten wonders") doctrinal apparatus of Zhìyǐ's *Xuányì*. The work is the earliest of the substantial Sòng *Shí bùèr mén* commentaries.

**Abstract**

Yuánqīng's *Shìzhū zhǐ* belongs to the very early Northern-Sòng productive period (Yuánqīng died in 1000, twenty-eight years before Zhīlǐ), making it the earliest substantial Sòng-period commentary on Zhànrán's *Shí bùèr mén* — predating Zhīlǐ's foundational *Zhǐyào chāo* ([KR6d0158](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0158)) by some quarter-century. The work is consequently of substantial historiographical interest as evidence for the pre-Zhīlǐ Sòng Tiāntái scholastic tradition.

The composition is bracketed within Yuánqīng's productive period c. 980–1000.
